scope: Retrospective source-time feasibility; never evidence of contemporaneous receipt, exact fills or P&L
known_before_declaration: Q2-T16 strict 0/1800 and component exclusions have been inspected. This is a predeclaration of new sensitivity calculations, not an untouched evaluation.
state_identity: Within each feed and second, quote identity is bid, ask, bid size, ask size, bidPastLow and askPastHigh; index identity is price. Also count full tick duplicates separately. Identical rows are redundant observations, not proven duplicate events.
selection: Greatest source second strictly before decision minus lag. Keep every state in that second. Never select by file/callback order or skip a bad/ambiguous latest second for an older clean one.
envelope: Keep strict validity, freshness and synchronization. Replace quote point-price uniqueness only with min/max over all states in the selected second. Index uniqueness remains required. Bounds are Cartesian outer bounds conditional on observed states; they do not prove simultaneous or executable markets.

bounds.straddle_bid: [min Cbid + min Pbid, max Cbid + max Pbid]
bounds.straddle_ask: [min Cask + min Pask, max Cask + max Pask]
bounds.parity_spread: [min Cbid - max Pask, max Cask - min Pbid]
bounds.pessimistic_displayed_roundtrip: max Cask + max Pask - min Cbid - min Pbid; descriptive points only, no fill or cost assumption

sensitivity.grid_phases: all integer phases; report min/max and totals, never select a favorable phase

delayed_candidate.age_policy: Age measured from actual decision, not lagged cutoff; same 5/60 second caps
delayed_candidate.adoption: Not adopted as causal replay: no receipt timestamp or proven latency bound. Score only as retrospective sensitivity; additional delay cannot recover same-second ordering.

trade_policy: Preserve original trade classifications, independently reconcile flags and causal quote exclusions. CBOE f complex trades never standalone fills; empty condition is not standalone proof.
missing_receipt_pessimistic_bound: Zero certified causal decisions in every candidate, irrespective of descriptive source-time coverage.
stopping_rule: Run this fixed candidate family once; implementation corrections are recorded. Do not tune thresholds to obtain a desired eligible count.
randomness: None; deterministic aggregation and exact decimal quote arithmetic
